existingSelection.method: All 55 original cases except five non-exact troubleshooting cases removed by fixed SHA256 key phase8-stratified-existing:<ID>. Preserves all original exact prompts, all eight conversations, course/language/lesson categories. Not selected by previous pass/fail outcome.

novelty: Questions and product scenarios authored after evaluator freeze, before any responses; no complete new question equals a prior frozen question or product local-test source. Same course concepts/approved headings necessarily recur. Never ingested into application knowledge or training.
